tool_args.rationale: Fresh confirmation narrowly refuted the current stationary escape fit. The existing low-gradient observation establishes a branch departure from the hydraulic sink law but cannot distinguish the source-described local sqrt branch from a leak term. Acquire the targeted, lower-cost open-branch probe before revising the model.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a revised hydraulic sink/branch model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The fitted stationary model missed fresh confirmation (RMSE 0.048177 > 0.045); the six training rows still do not identify whether the low-gradient deviation is a local sqrt branch or a leak/mass-drift branch.
The archive ties this costly batch to a four-parameter memory ODE needing at least eight rows; no trajectory or memory signature supports that mechanism.
Nuisance measurements do not resolve the relevant structural branch ambiguity and are explicitly not useful here.
The fresh miss alone is not evidence of non-stationary chaotic behavior; a relevant branch-discriminating measurement remains available.
